info.title: Arete Gateway — Local Service API
info.description:
Local REST/SSE face for CNS/CP realm participation. Apps declare capabilities, observe governed connections, and exchange properties over plain HTTP — no SDK embedded.

The architecture is carried into the API shape: **declarations are writable; connections are read-only.** The app performs Declare; the substrate performs Reconcile, Match, Bind. Connections appear — they are never created by the app. To leave, DELETE (retract) a declaration, context or node; the substrate severs anything that depended on it.

All writes are PUT with client-chosen ids and idempotent under retry (identical re-PUT = 200 no-op). Two POSTs exist, both server-named creations: capability minting and webhook test delivery.

Companion surfaces (not part of this contract): `/ui` — the live console; `/docs` — this spec rendered interactively. Architecture background: ARETE.md.

post.description: Deliberately bypasses the hook's filter — it is a connectivity check for the whole delivery path, signature included.

404.description: The addressed resource does not exist (realm not attached, node/context/declaration not declared through this gateway, connection or webhook unknown).

200.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 description of this gateway.

post.summary: Event delivery to a registered webhook URL
post.description: One event per delivery. Strict per-hook ordering: a failed delivery is retried (exponential backoff, up to 24h) before anything after it. At-least-once — dedupe on `eventId`. The request body is signed: `X-Arete-Signature` is the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the exact body bytes using the hook's secret. `webhook.test` events (from POST /v0/webhooks/{hook}/test) bypass the hook's filter by design.

parameters.name: X-Arete-Signature
parameters.description: hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, body)) — present when the hook has a secret.

200.description: Any 2xx acknowledges delivery; anything else (or a timeout) triggers retry.

localToken.description: The gateway's local API token (data/local-token or config.localToken). Full access. For SSE, `?token=` is accepted on GET /v0/events only, because EventSource cannot set headers.

capabilityToken.description: A minted device credential: exactly one connection, named properties, one direction. Valid ONLY on that connection's properties endpoints; every other route returns 403 capability_scope. Dies with the binding (410).

Realm.description: The realm token is write-only: accepted in the PUT body, never echoed (hasToken only).

token.description: Realm Bearer token. Stored by the gateway, never echoed.

insecureTls.description: Per-realm, per-socket TLS relaxation for self-signed realms. Never process-wide.

properties.description: Optional initial values — only applied on a FRESH declaration (replay never re-writes them: value-wiper protection). Each property must belong to this role per the CP's server flag.

Connection.description: Read-only. Appears via Match/Bind; disappears when a side retracts. `properties` is the merged view — both sides' current values.

Event.description: The event envelope, identical over SSE and webhooks.

eventId.description: Carries a boot epoch — a Last-Event-ID from a previous gateway process degrades to full-buffer replay, never a silent gap.

data.description: For property.changed: { property, value, previous, origin: "peer"|"self"|"unknown" }. For connection.created: { peer }.

Webhook.description: The secret is stored but never echoed (hasSecret only).

events.description: Omit for all types. Unknown types are refused at registration (422).

Capability.description: Public record — the token itself is returned once at mint and only its hash is stored.

properties.description: Attenuating: may only name properties the gateway itself may write on this side (checked at mint against CP flags).
